What happens to items without a name?
They go to the lost and found box and are given away after one month.

A Chennai author will read from her children's book at the library next Saturday at 11 am. Children may ask her questions afterwards. Signed copies will be available at the counter, and tea will be served for parents. The library is on Temple Road, beside the post office, and the reading room is open to all.

Where can signed copies be bought?
Signed copies will be available at the counter.

Mum, I am at Nani's house. I reached at four, and she made me sweet lassi. I will stay for dinner, and Mama Ravi will drop me home at about eight. Please don't worry. I have taken my school bag, so I can finish my homework here.

Who will bring the writer home?
Mama Ravi will drop the writer home at about eight.

Bus fees for the next term are due by the 5th. Parents can pay at the office between 9 am and noon, or put the money in a sealed envelope with the child's name and class on it. A receipt will be sent home the next day.

How will parents get a receipt?
A receipt will be sent home the next day.

The nature walk will begin at the east gate of the park at 6:30 am. We will look at birds, butterflies and old trees. Walkers should wear sturdy shoes and carry water. The walk will last about ninety minutes.

How long will the walk last?
The walk will last about ninety minutes.

Coach's message: tomorrow's practice is cancelled because the field is wet. Instead, we will meet in the gym at four to watch a video of last week's match. Bring a notebook to write down what we can improve. Please also get some rest and drink plenty of water today.

Why is practice cancelled?
Practice is cancelled because the field is wet.

The temple fair starts on Thursday. Vendors will sell bangles, toys and sweets. A small elephant will lead the opening procession. Please keep little children close to you in the crowd. The fair is held in the same field every year, and many families from nearby villages visit it.

Why should you stay close to children in a crowd?
The text doesn't say, but in a crowd small children can easily get lost or hurt, so staying close keeps them safe.

On Friday, Aman borrowed a book about explorers from the library and took it home. He liked the chapter on a sailor who crossed an ocean in a small boat. He decided to draw a map of the voyage and show it to his class.

What is an explorer?
The text doesn't say, but an explorer is a person who travels to unknown places to learn about them.

Skating rink rules: all skaters must wear helmets and knee pads. Beginners should stay on the left side. No running or pushing. The rink closes for cleaning every day from one to two in the afternoon. The rink is at the back of the sports complex, near the tennis courts and the small cafe.

When does the rink close for cleaning?
It closes from one to two in the afternoon.

Piano lessons for beginners in the evenings. Learn simple songs in your first month. Lessons are for children and adults. A keyboard can be hired for practice at home. Call to book a free trial lesson. The teacher has been playing for many years and teaches at a small studio near the market.

How many keys does a standard piano have?
The text doesn't say, but a standard piano has eighty-eight keys.

At the sports meet, Tara won the long jump and a silver medal in the 100-metre race. She said that practising every morning before school helped her. Her parents were in the crowd and waved a banner. The meet was held at the district stadium, and many schools sent their best young athletes.

What is a medal?
The text doesn't say, but a medal is a small metal disc given as a prize for winning or achieving something.

Christmas cake mixing happens at our home in November. The family gathers in the kitchen, and each person stirs the fruit mix and makes a wish. The mix is then kept in a jar for several weeks before baking.

What does each person do while stirring?
Each person makes a wish while stirring the fruit mix.

Notice: due to heavy rain, the lake path is closed until further notice. Visitors can still use the garden path and the picnic area. The park staff will put up a sign when the lake path reopens. The lake is the park's most popular spot, and many families walk there on weekends.

Which paths can visitors still use?
Visitors can still use the garden path and the picnic area.

A small grey squirrel lived in the old neem tree outside Kavya's window. Every morning it came to the sill to take a peanut from her hand. Last week it brought a friend, and now two squirrels wait for her at breakfast time.

How many squirrels now come to the window?
Two squirrels now come to the window.

The family reached the hill station after a long drive. The air was cool, and the children ran to the garden of the cottage. Dad carried the bags, and Mum looked for the key under the flowerpot, as the owner had said.

What was the number of the cottage?
The text doesn't say, and I don't know the cottage number. You could check the booking message.

Tree planting day is next Sunday at the riverside. Volunteers should meet at 7 am by the old bridge and bring gloves and a hat. Saplings and spades will be provided by the garden club. Lunch will be a simple picnic.

Why do people plant trees?
The text doesn't say, but trees give shade, clean the air and give homes to birds and insects.

Pack list for the desert camp: a cotton scarf, sunglasses, one warm sweater for the night, and a reusable water bottle. Camels are available for rides at sunrise. Tents have beds with thick blankets. The camp is two hours by jeep from the town, and the road is bumpy in the last part.

Why is a warm sweater on the list?
It is for the night, which gets cold at the desert camp.

Cleaning duty chart: Aarav waters the plants on Mondays, Zoya sweeps the balcony on Wednesdays, and Dad washes the car on Saturdays. Whoever forgets must wash the dishes for a day. The chart is stuck on the fridge door. The family made the chart together on Sunday and everyone helped to choose their own jobs.

Why do plants need water?
The text doesn't say, but plants need water to grow, take in food from the soil and stay alive.

Class 7B timetable for Monday: period one is Maths, period two is English, and period three is Science in the lab. Lunch is at 12:30. After lunch there is Hindi, then Games on the ground. Students should bring their lab coats for Science. The last bell rings at 3:15.

Which subject comes right after lunch?
Hindi comes right after lunch.

Lunch at Gita's house is always rice, dal and one vegetable. Her grandmother serves it on steel plates and adds a spoon of ghee. On Sundays there is also a sweet and a papad. Gita's house is near the school, and her friends often visit her for a short study session.

What is dal made from?
The text doesn't say, but dal is made from lentils or split pulses.

The tailor's shop opens at ten and closes at eight. Two men work on the machines, and one woman sews buttons and does the finishing. Orders are written in a red book, and every item has a tag with the customer's name.

What does a tailor make?
The text doesn't say, but a tailor makes and mends clothes.

Zara scored two goals in the football match today. Her team won three to one. The coach praised her passing, and the team went for juice after the game. The match was played on the school ground, and a few parents came to watch from the side.

What is a pass in football?
The text doesn't say, but a pass is when a player kicks the ball to a teammate.

Ravi came to class with a new haircut. The teacher noticed and smiled, but she asked him to finish copying the notes. Ravi opened his notebook, found a pencil, and began to write quickly before the bell. The room was warm that morning, and the fan above the board made a soft humming noise.

What was the subject of the class?
The text doesn't say, and I don't know the subject. You could check the class timetable.

Join us for the Christmas carol evening at St. Mary's Hall on Saturday at 6 pm. The children's choir will sing, and there will be cake and tea afterwards. Entry is free. Please bring a candle if you would like to join the walk around the garden.

Who is leading the choir this year?
The text doesn't say, and I don't know who leads the choir. You could ask the hall office.

The plumber says the leak in our bathroom is from an old pipe behind the wall. He will come back tomorrow with a new one. Until then, Dad will turn off the water at the main tap every evening.

Where is the leak coming from?
The leak is coming from an old pipe behind the wall.

Sunil walked along the river every morning to watch the kingfishers dive. This morning the water was calm and clear. He sat on a flat rock and counted three birds before it was time to go to school.

Why are kingfishers good at catching fish?
The text doesn't say, but kingfishers have sharp eyesight and a long pointed beak that lets them dive and grab fish fast.

The Hindi essay contest is open to Classes 6 to 8. The topic is My Village. Essays must be handwritten and should not be longer than two pages. Submit them to the Hindi teacher by Friday. First prize is a set of books.

What is the topic of the contest?
The topic is My Village.

The Class 3 spelling bee will be held on Thursday in the library. Twenty words will be given to each child in advance. The best speller will get a certificate and a pencil box. The library will be closed to other students during that hour so that the contest is quiet.

What will the best speller receive?
The best speller will receive a certificate and a pencil box.

Teacher's note: Aditi has been helping classmates with spelling this week. She made a small chart of tricky words and put it on the wall. Several students now check it before writing their homework. I am proud of her effort.

What did Aditi put on the wall?
She put up a small chart of tricky words.

The school library is open from 8:00 to 4:00 on weekdays. Students may borrow two books at a time for ten days. Reference books and newspapers must be read inside the library. Please keep your voices low and return books to the right shelf.

Who is the head librarian?
The text doesn't say, and I don't know who the head librarian is. You could ask at the library desk.

From next week, the school gates will open at 7:40 am. Children who arrive earlier must wait in the covered area near the office. The security guard will not let anyone inside before that time. This is for the safety of all students.

When will the gates open?
The gates will open at 7:40 am.

The new bakery assistant, Dev, starts on Monday. He will learn to knead dough with Mrs. Khan for the first two weeks. After that he will work at the front counter. Please be kind and show him where the aprons are kept.

Who will teach Dev to knead dough?
Mrs. Khan will teach him.

The school fair will have a small bank counter where students can change large notes into coins for the stalls. The counter is run by the Class 10 volunteers and will be open from 10 am to noon at the entrance.

Who runs the counter?
The Class 10 volunteers run the counter.

Mr. Iyer sells newspapers on the corner of the main road. He arrives at five, sorts the papers into piles, and sets up his stall. Regular customers pick up their copy and drop the money in a tin.

How many newspapers does Mr. Iyer sell a day?
The text doesn't say, and I don't know how many papers he sells. You could ask Mr. Iyer.

Basketball trials for the junior team will be held on the school court on Friday. Players from Classes 6 to 8 may try out. Please wear sports shoes. The coach will pick twelve players for the squad after watching a short practice game.

Who is the coach?
The text doesn't say, and I don't know who the coach is. You could ask the sports teacher.

This holiday we are going to Goa by train. The journey will take a full day, and we will play board games and read. My sister has packed her sketchbook, and I have my camera. We will get off at Madgaon.

On which coast is Goa?
The text doesn't say, but Goa is on the west coast of India.

Come to the village fair on Saturday! There will be a Ferris wheel, folk dancers, kite flying and many food stalls. The fair opens at noon and ends at midnight. A shuttle will run from the bus stand every fifteen minutes.

Is there a charge to enter the fair?
The text doesn't say, and I don't know if there is an entry charge. The fair committee can tell you.

Team, the weekly meeting has moved from Monday to Tuesday at 11 am because the manager will be travelling on Monday. We will meet in the small conference room. Please send your progress notes to Anita by Monday evening. Please keep the notes short and clear, as we will show them on the screen.

Why was the meeting moved?
It was moved because the manager will be travelling on Monday.

Tea stall board: tea 10 rupees, coffee 15 rupees, bun maska 20 rupees, samosa 12 rupees. Free sugar on request. Closed on Sundays. Please do not leave glasses on the bench. The stall stands under a large tree at the corner of the market, opposite the bus stop.

Which day is the stall closed?
The stall is closed on Sundays.

The Sharma family restaurant now offers a Sunday thali with five vegetables, dal, rice, roti and a sweet. It is served from noon to 3 pm. Families can book a table by phone. A children's portion is also available.

What sweet is served in the thali?

Why was the exam postponed?
It was postponed because of a power cut in the exam hall.

Handmade candles and soaps for sale at the Sunday craft market. All items are made by a women's group from the next village. Prices start at twenty rupees. A cloth bag is free with every four items. The market is set up on the playground behind the temple and runs from morning until evening.

Who makes the items?
A women's group from the next village makes them.

Our Diwali fair will be held in the school courtyard on Friday from 4 pm to 8 pm. Students will sell handmade diyas, cards and sweets. All money raised will go to the school's new library fund. Rangoli competition winners will be announced at 6 pm.

What will the money raised be used for?
The money will go to the school's new library fund.

Metro update: trains on the Blue Line will run every ten minutes instead of every six minutes tomorrow, because of maintenance on the tracks. The last train will leave at 10 pm. Smart cards will work as usual.

How often will Blue Line trains run tomorrow?
They will run every ten minutes.

The mid-day meal today was khichdi with pickle. The cook, Savita, said it was her mother's recipe, with a little ghee on top. The children finished every bite and asked for more, but there was none left. The school serves the meal at 12:30, and children sit in rows on the mats in the hall.

Our bus to the hill station leaves at 5 am from the school gate. Please carry a light jacket, a water bottle and your packed breakfast. Parents should sign the permission slip by Friday. We will return before dark on Sunday.

What should children wear on Friday?
They should wear their blue house T-shirt.

My grandmother's pickle recipe uses green mangoes, mustard oil, salt and red chilli. She dries the mango pieces in the sun for two days first. Then she packs everything into a jar and keeps it in a corner of the kitchen for a week.

Why is salt used to preserve food?
The text doesn't say, but salt draws water out of food, which makes it hard for germs to grow.

The Class 10 farewell will be held on Saturday evening in the hall. Juniors have prepared songs and a small skit. Seniors will receive a memory book signed by their teachers. The hall will be decorated by the juniors with balloons, and refreshments will be served at the end.

The text doesn't say, but a farewell is a goodbye event for someone who is leaving.

The inter-school cricket match will start at 8:30 on Saturday at the Municipal ground. Our team must reach by 7:45 for the warm-up. Players should wear white clothes and bring their own water bottles. Coach Rahim will give out the batting order at the ground.

When must the team arrive?
The team must arrive by 7:45 for the warm-up.

By bus, the trip from our town to the lake takes two hours, but by shared jeep it takes ninety minutes. The jeep costs a little more. The last jeep back leaves the lake at four in the afternoon.

Which is faster, the bus or the jeep?
The jeep is faster, taking ninety minutes against two hours for the bus.

Welcome to the new term! Classes begin on Monday. Please check your timetable on the notice board. New students should meet their class teachers in the hall at 8:30 am for a short introduction. The school has a new playground this year, and the first assembly will be held there on Monday.

What is a school term?
The text doesn't say, but a term is one of the parts a school year is divided into, usually with holidays in between.

Found in the canteen on Friday: a black umbrella with a wooden handle. The owner can collect it from the school office. Please describe the umbrella to the clerk to prove it is yours. Items that are not claimed by the end of the month will be given away.

What is an umbrella used for?
The text doesn't say, but an umbrella protects you from rain or strong sun.

This is how Nani makes sweet kheer: boil the milk, add washed rice, and stir slowly. When the rice is soft, add sugar and a few strands of saffron. Garnish with chopped nuts and serve it warm or cold.

What does Nani use to garnish the kheer?
She garnishes it with chopped nuts.

The Heritage Walk starts from the clock tower at 7 am on Sunday and ends at the old market. Walkers will see three temples and a stepwell. The walk is mostly on flat ground. Wear comfortable shoes and bring a cap.

Who will be the guide for the walk?
The text doesn't say, and I don't know who the guide is. The organisers should be able to tell you.

Cooking class this Thursday: we will make vegetable upma and a simple tomato chutney. Each student should bring one onion and one tomato. The class will start at 3 pm in the home science room. Aprons are provided.

Why do cooks wash vegetables before cutting them?
The text doesn't say, but cooks wash vegetables to remove dirt and germs before eating them.

Tourist tip card: at the temple town, shoes must be left at the entrance counter. A token is given, so keep it safe. The entrance is open from 5 am to noon and again from 4 pm to 9 pm. Dress modestly.

What must visitors do with their shoes?
They must leave their shoes at the entrance counter.

Last night I finished a novel about a boy who builds a boat from old doors and sails down a river. I liked how patient he was, and I loved the part where he repaired a leak with his own shirt. The ending made me smile.

What did the boy use to build his boat?
He used old doors.

Power cut notice: the electricity department will shut off power in the Lakshmi Nagar area on Wednesday for repair of cables. Residents are asked to charge their lamps and phones in advance. Normal supply will return after the work is done.

At what time will the power return?
The text doesn't say, and I don't know when the power will return. You could call the electricity office to ask.

The chef at Anjali's cafe starts at five in the morning to bake the day's bread. By seven, the first loaves are ready, and the smell spreads across the street. Customers queue at the door before the shop even opens.

When does the chef start work?
The chef starts at five in the morning.

Yoga lessons for beginners start Monday at 6 am in the community park. The class is forty-five minutes long. Please bring a mat and wear loose clothes. The first week is free for new members. The teacher will guide each step slowly, so no experience is needed.

Which week is free?
The first week is free for new members.

Check-in desk notice: guests arriving before noon may leave luggage in the cloakroom until rooms are ready at 2 pm. A voucher for a free welcome drink is included in each booking. Please ask at the desk. The cloakroom is beside the front desk, and the staff will tag each bag with a number.

When will rooms be ready?
Rooms will be ready at 2 pm.

The tour bus will stop at the Taj Mahal viewpoint for forty minutes. Please be back at the bus on time. Visitors are asked to carry their own water and wear a hat. The next stop is lunch at a roadside restaurant.

In which city is the Taj Mahal?
The text doesn't say, but the Taj Mahal is in Agra.

Anil practises the harmonium for half an hour before dinner. His teacher says he has improved a lot in his scales. On Saturday he will play a short devotional song for the neighbours. His father bought the small harmonium for him from a shop in the old market a year ago.

What does a scale mean in music?
The text doesn't say, but a scale is a set of notes played in order, going up or down.

The Onam flower carpet competition will be held in the school courtyard. Each class gets one hour and a large circle drawn in chalk. Only natural petals and leaves are allowed. Judges will walk around at noon. The courtyard will be closed to other activities during that time and the students will be seated nearby.

What is allowed for the carpets?
Only natural petals and leaves are allowed.

Tomorrow's school lunch will be rajma and rice with a green salad. Children who bring their own tiffin may eat in the same hall. Please check with your child about any food they cannot eat and tell the class teacher today.

What will be served for lunch tomorrow?
Rajma and rice with a green salad will be served.

Parent-teacher meeting for Class 5 will be on Friday at 2 pm. Each parent will have a ten-minute talk with the class teacher. Please bring your child's report card and sign the attendance sheet at the door. The meeting will be held in the classroom, and a teacher will wait outside to show the way.

What should parents bring to the meeting?
Parents should bring their child's report card.

Dear guests, breakfast at the guest house is served from 7:30 to 9:30 in the dining room on the ground floor. Check-out time is 11 am. Please leave your room key at the front desk when you go. We hope you enjoyed your stay.

What is breakfast?
The text doesn't say, but breakfast is the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning.

Notice to all residents: the water tank in Block C will be cleaned on Saturday from 9 am to 1 pm. There will be no water supply during this time. Please store enough water on Friday evening. Blocks A and B will have water as usual.

How long will the water be off in Block C?
The water will be off from 9 am to 1 pm on Saturday, which is four hours.

The Class 9 science exhibition is next week. Each group must tell the teacher the title of their project by Wednesday. Models should be small enough to fit on one table. Judges will visit each table between 10 and 12.

Which group will win first prize?
The text doesn't say, and I can't know who will win. The judges will decide that on the day.

My uncle Farid drives a taxi in Hyderabad. He starts at six, takes a break at two, and finishes at nine. On Sundays he picks up our family from the station and tells us stories about the strange passengers he meets.

What does Uncle Farid do on Sundays?
He picks up the family from the station and tells stories about his passengers.

The school bus for Route 4 will pick students up fifteen minutes earlier from Monday. The first stop will be at the temple corner at 6:45 am. Please make sure your child is waiting at the stop on time, as the bus cannot wait.

When is the first stop on Route 4?
The first stop is at the temple corner at 6:45 am.

Eid dinner invitation: please join us at our home on Saturday evening at 7 pm for biryani and sweet seviyan. Children are welcome. Please tell us by Thursday if you can come so that we can plan the food. The house is near the temple, and a few guests have already said they will arrive early.

What is seviyan?
The text doesn't say, but seviyan is a sweet dish of thin vermicelli cooked in milk and sugar, often made for Eid.

The staff room will be painted over the weekend. Teachers are asked to remove their personal items and papers from the shelves by Friday afternoon. The room will be ready again on Monday morning. The painters will arrive on Saturday morning, and the caretaker will lock the door when they leave.

Why do people paint rooms?
The text doesn't say, but people paint rooms to make them look fresh and clean and to protect the walls.

Spring flower show at the botanical garden: roses, marigolds, tulips and an orchid house. Entry is by ticket at the main gate. A small cafe near the lake sells snacks. Photography is allowed, but please do not pick the flowers.

How many types of roses are on show?
The text doesn't say, and I don't know how many types of roses there are. The garden office may know.

The school bus will stop at the railway crossing every day because of a new rule. Children must stay seated, and the driver will look both ways. This is why the trip now takes an extra ten minutes.

Why does the trip take ten extra minutes?
The bus now stops at the railway crossing every day.

Recipe card: to make lemon rice, cook one cup of rice and let it cool. Heat oil, add mustard seeds, curry leaves and peanuts. Mix in turmeric and the rice. Squeeze in the juice of one lemon and add salt just before serving.

When should you add the salt?
You should add the salt just before serving.

Thank you for booking with Sunrise Tours. Your pick-up is at the hotel lobby at 6 am on Tuesday. The drive to the waterfall takes about three hours, with a tea stop on the way. Please carry a towel, because the pool below the fall is safe for swimming.

How long is the drive to the waterfall?
The drive takes about three hours.

For sale: a blue children's bicycle, suitable for ages six to nine. It has new tyres and a small basket at the front. Price is 2,500 rupees, but the owner will take a little less for a quick sale. Call after 6 pm and ask for Meena.

Who should you ask for when you call?
You should ask for Meena.

Dark clouds covered the sky by afternoon, and a cool wind began to blow. Neha ran to pull the washing off the line before the rain began. A minute later, the first heavy drops hit the terrace. The terrace is on the third floor, and the washing line runs along the whole length of it.

Why do dark clouds often mean rain is coming?
The text doesn't say, but dark clouds are thick with water drops, so they often bring rain.

A short message from the colony committee: the lift in Tower B will be repaired on Thursday. Please use the stairs between ten and two. Elderly residents who need help can call the security desk, and a guard will carry their bags.

Who can carry bags for elderly residents?
A guard from the security desk can carry their bags.

Hello everyone, this is Mr. Verma. Tomorrow's science test is only on chapters four and five. You may use a ruler and a pencil but no calculators. The test will take forty minutes. Please sleep early tonight. I will start as soon as the bell rings, so please be on time.

Which chapters are in the test?
The test is on chapters four and five.

Monsoon warning in the school diary: students should carry raincoats and keep a spare pair of socks in the bag. If the roads flood, the school will send a message to parents by 7 am. Buses will not run on flooded roads.

What season is the monsoon?
The text doesn't say, but the monsoon is the rainy season.

The 6:40 am express to Pune leaves from Platform 3 today instead of Platform 5. Passengers with seats in coaches S1 to S4 should wait near the front of the train. The platform change was needed because of track repair work near the main gate.

Why did the platform change?
The platform changed because of track repair work near the main gate.

Our family is hosting a small Raksha Bandhan lunch on Sunday at one o'clock. Cousins from Nagpur are arriving on Saturday night. Mother will make kheer and puri, and Dad is arranging the music. Please bring your own rakhi if you like.

When are the cousins arriving?

They are selling them because they are moving to another city on the 30th.

The fabric softener goes in the right tray.

The text doesn't say, and I don't know the band's name. You could look at the concert poster or ticket.

The night train from Jaipur arrives at Platform 2. A tea stall and a waiting room are available near the entrance. Please keep your tickets ready for the checker. Luggage trolleys can be found at the ramp. The station is old and has a long platform with benches, and a bookstall near the exit.

What should students learn by heart?
They should learn the second verse of the anthem.

Class 6 parents, please note: the picnic to the botanical garden is on Thursday. The bus leaves at 8 am and returns at 3 pm. Children should wear their house T-shirts and bring a packed lunch with no glass bottles. Please send the signed form tomorrow.

What kind of bottle must children not bring?
They must not bring glass bottles.

Who rests under the tree at noon?
Farmers rest under the tree at noon.

This weekend our school hosts a kho-kho tournament. Four teams will play on the dirt court near the gym. Each match lasts fifteen minutes. A cold drink will be offered to every player. The court has been marked with white lines, and the sports teacher will referee all of the matches.

In kho-kho, what do the chasers try to do?
The text doesn't say, but in kho-kho the chasers try to touch the runners of the other team to get them out.

A new student named Kiran joined Class 6 today. He sat at the back and spoke very little, but he smiled when Ms. Roy greeted him. At lunch two boys invited him to share their table. The class has thirty students, and the teacher had planned a short activity to help him settle in.

The text doesn't say, and I don't know where Kiran studied before. You could ask Kiran or his class teacher.

New rule in our house: phones go into the basket at 9 pm. Mum puts hers in too. The idea came from my sister after she noticed everyone was scrolling at dinner. It's been two weeks, and we have started playing board games instead.

Where do the phones go at 9 pm?
The phones go into a basket.

The street musicians' group is looking for a young flute player. Rehearsals happen on Sunday evenings at the old school hall. You do not need to be a professional, but you must be able to play a simple tune. Come and listen first if you are shy.

The text doesn't say, and I don't know how long the group has played. You could ask them at a rehearsal.

The story of Pari, a girl in a small mountain village, is in this week's reading class. Pari walks two hours every day to school and shares her lunch with a stray dog on the way. Today we will read the part where the dog follows her into class.

What does Pari share with the dog?
She shares her lunch with the dog.

Tiger Reserve update: visitors are allowed in jeeps only, and the safari times are 6 to 9 am and 3 to 6 pm. Staying inside the vehicle is a must. A guide goes with each jeep and shows pugmarks and bird calls.

Who goes with each jeep?
A guide goes with each jeep.

It has not rained in our town for three weeks. The farmers are worried about their crops, and the lake has shrunk. People are asked to use water carefully and not to waste it washing cars. The town usually gets most of its rain between June and September, so everyone is watching the sky.

Why do farmers need rain?
The text doesn't say, but farmers need rain to water their crops so that the plants can grow.

Fresh farm vegetables sold every Sunday morning in front of the temple. Tomatoes, spinach, brinjal and okra picked the same day. Bring your own cloth bag. The stall opens at 6 am and usually sells out by nine.

Why do some shops ask you to bring your own bag?
The text doesn't say, but bringing your own bag cuts down on plastic waste and helps the environment.

Lost cat: our grey cat Misty has not come home since Tuesday. She is small, wears a red collar and is shy of strangers. If you see her, please call Priya at the number below or leave a note at Flat 2A.

What do cats usually eat?
The text doesn't say, but cats usually eat meat or fish, and many pet cats are also fed special cat food.

The team will receive their cup on Monday.

Mango season special: our juice shop is selling fresh Alphonso mango shakes from today until the end of June. A large glass costs 60 rupees, and a small one 40. We use no added colour. Cash or card is fine.

Until when will the shakes be sold?
They will be sold until the end of June.

Boarding for the evening flight to Delhi opens at 5:10 pm at Gate 4. Please keep your boarding pass and ID ready. Cabin baggage should fit in the overhead locker. Seats are assigned, so you do not need to hurry.

Chef's note: the best way to keep chapatis soft is to wrap them in a clean cloth as soon as they come off the pan. The steam stays inside, and the chapatis remain warm and soft for an hour or more.

How does the cloth help the chapatis?
The cloth keeps the steam inside, so the chapatis stay warm and soft.

The Class 8 debate is on whether students should wear uniforms. Each side gets three minutes to speak. A student from Class 9 will keep time with a bell. The audience can ask one question each. The debate will be held in the school hall after lunch, and the whole class has been invited.

What is a debate?
The text doesn't say, but a debate is a formal discussion where two sides give reasons for and against an idea.

This week, the power outage in our area lasted two hours each evening. We lit candles and played antakshari. Mum cooked dinner early, and Dad read stories to the little ones. The cut was caused by repairs on the main line, and the neighbours shared candles with one another.

What is an outage?
The text doesn't say, but an outage is a time when a service such as power or water stops working.

Sheela found a bird's nest in the guava tree. It had three tiny blue eggs. She told her brother not to touch it, and they watched from far away. A few days later, the eggs hatched into three noisy chicks. The tree is at the back of their garden, and the family has put a small sign near it.

How many chicks hatched?
Three chicks hatched.

The ferry to the island leaves the jetty every two hours, starting at 8 am. Passengers should arrive fifteen minutes early. Life jackets are handed out at the gate. The last ferry back is at 5 pm. The island is a short ride from the shore, and many visitors go there to see the old temple.

What is a ferry?
The text doesn't say, but a ferry is a boat that carries people and vehicles across water.

Karate classes for kids start on the 1st. Beginners should wear loose white clothes. Classes are on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays at five o'clock. The first lesson is free. The classes are held in the school hall, and the instructor has been teaching for several years.

What country does karate come from?
The text doesn't say, but karate comes from Japan.

Kabir's mother made tea and put out a plate of biscuits. They sat on the veranda to listen to the rain. His father read the newspaper, and his grandmother hummed an old song. The rain had started in the afternoon and went on until evening, with a cool breeze in the air.

What is a veranda?
The text doesn't say, but a veranda is a roofed open space along the side of a house.

New health food shop opening on Park Road. We sell dry fruits, millets, honey and cold-pressed oil. Opening week offer: buy two packs of almonds and get a small jar of honey free. We deliver within three kilometres. The shop is next to the pharmacy, and the owners will welcome visitors with a cup of herbal tea.

What is the opening week offer?
Buy two packs of almonds and get a small jar of honey free.

The text doesn't say, and I don't know if there is parking. Please ask Mr. Ghosh when you call.

When is the fort closed?
The fort is closed on Mondays.

Our colony has started a small kitchen garden on the terrace. Neighbours bring kitchen scraps for compost and take turns watering. This month the first chillies and coriander came up. The text doesn't say, but compost is rotted plant waste that is mixed into soil to help plants grow.

Raj lost his first tooth.

Please note that the canteen at the factory will be closed on Friday. Workers should bring their own lunch. The canteen will reopen on Monday with a new menu. Tea and water will still be available from the dispenser near the gate.

Tea and water will still be available from the dispenser near the gate.

The children made paper boats.

The main ground is being levelled.

Winter has arrived in Shimla. On Sunday morning, the first snow fell on the hills and covered the road to the temple. Shops sold hot tea and woollen caps to the early visitors. The town is a popular place for tourists in winter, and hotels are usually full by December.

The book club will meet this Saturday at 4 pm in the garden of the community library. We will talk about the short story we read last week. Members should bring one question to share. Snacks will be provided by Tanvi.

A free violin workshop will be given at the community hall on Saturday at 11 am. Instruments will be provided for children who do not own one. Please wear comfortable clothes. Parents may watch from the back of the hall.

Orchard fresh apples, 80 rupees a kilo, are on sale at the Tuesday market. The farmer, Mr. Thakur, brings them from the hills and says they are sweetest in October. He packs them in paper bags, not plastic.

How does Mr. Thakur pack the apples?
He packs them in paper bags.

The houseboat in Alleppey has two bedrooms, a deck, and a small kitchen. Meals are cooked by the boat crew. The boat moves slowly through the backwaters, and guests can watch birds from the deck. The boat is white with a brown roof, and it is tied to a wooden jetty near the old bridge.

Karan plays the tabla.

The zoo's elephant house is closed for painting this week. Visitors can still see the deer park and the reptile house. The zoo is open from 9 am to 5 pm. Please do not feed the animals. The zoo has a small cafe near the main gate, and a shaded rest area beside the deer park.

Each child gets a small paper lantern.

Library notice: the reading hall will be quiet from 3 pm to 5 pm every day during exams. Please do not hold group discussions inside. Students who need to talk may use the corridor benches outside the hall.

They can talk on the corridor benches outside the hall.

How will the results reach parents?
The results will be sent home in a sealed note.

Our housing society's annual meeting will be held in the clubhouse on the first Sunday of next month at 10 am. All families are asked to send one member. Tea and biscuits will be served. The treasurer will present the yearly accounts.

Poems can be no longer than sixteen lines.

He adds ginger and cardamom.

The text doesn't say, and I don't know how many days each person gets. Please ask your team lead.
